mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 67 degrees near Harriet Park, and we are under a First Quarter moon. The temperature will dip to a low of 42 degrees overnight, and rain is not in the forecast.

City Hall is highlighting the Stormwater Utility Credit program, which offers billing discounts to property owners who install rain barrels or infiltration systems. Additionally, the department is reminding residents to review the Sugar River Supporter pledge to help reduce local pollution.

We have a busy week ahead in Verona. Yoga at Insight Wellness is available today. Looking toward tomorrow, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee, followed by more trivia and live music options throughout the rest of the week.

On Thursday, the Verona Police Department conducted an arrest of a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving behavior while students were being transported. No injuries were reported, and the incident remains under investigation.
If you are craving something sweet, head over to Culver's to try today's delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is currently open and will remain open for your enjoyment until 10:00 PM.
